name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: I say we swap EXCAVA’s current tokenizer for the brand-new **Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenizer from Mistral AI**—it’s already proven to cut token waste by 8-12% on similar tasks, which directly lifts EXCAVA’s throughput. The trade-off is a one-time rebuild of our embedding pipeline, but the jump in raw speed outweighs the setup pain.

name: Torque
text: Torque: Swapping tokenizers mid-stream isn’t just a “one-time rebuild”—it’s a full pipeline audit risk. If EXCAVA’s downstream models were trained on the old tokenizer, we’re gambling on silent embedding drift that could *lower* accuracy more than the 8-12% token savings lift throughput. Let’s first run a controlled A/B on a 1% slice of data with the Mistral tokenizer *and* a fresh embedding layer, then measure both token waste *and* model loss. If the loss delta is <0.1%, we greenlight it; else, we scrap the idea.

name: Gearbox
text:
Gearbox (power-w1): I say we run a **controlled A/B bake-off** between the new Mistral BPE tokenizer and EXCAVA’s current one, but only on the 10% of data that feeds the final embedding layer. We measure token waste *and* downstream accuracy drop side-by-side. If the new tokenizer wins on both counts, we swap it; if not, we keep the old one and save the rebuild. Trade-off: we spend a week on the bake-off, but we avoid a risky full pipeline overhaul unless the numbers prove it’s worth it.
[dispatched 3 workers: worker-2889, worker-7567, worker-2255 — done, dissolved]

name: Torque
text: Torque: A controlled A/B bake-off sounds promising, but we need to scrutinize the risk of introducing variability in our results. Testing only 10% of the final embedding layer data may not represent the overall system performance accurately. To settle this argument, we should consider a broader test across representative data subsets or simulate the full pipeline with both tokenizers to see how they perform end-to-end. This would give us a clearer picture of potential accuracy impacts alongside efficiency gains.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Run a full-system A/B bake-off comparing the Mistral BPE tokenizer vs. EXCAVA’s current one on 100% of production data, measuring token waste *and* downstream accuracy—Gearbox owns the test design and Torque owns the risk audit.
